diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~27% of its level). A moderate seasonal pattern is present. The series crosses zero, so percentage errors are unstable and mean-based combinations are safer than ratio-based ones. Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.602), which favours a selective combination.
